    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if len(markers) != 2:
        return out
    # The marker adjacent to the colored pattern is its anchor; the isolated marker is the copy location.
    def nearby(anchor, other):
        ar, ac = anchor
        return [(r-ar, c-ac, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0]))
                if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c] != 5 and (r, c) != other]

    target_anchor = markers[1] if source_anchor == markers[0] else markers[0]
    tr, tc = target_anchor
    out[tr][tc] = 0
    for dr, dc, color in offsets:
        r, c = tr + dr, tc + dc
        if 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]):

    return out
'''

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if len(markers) != 2:
        return out
    colored = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 5)]
    def distance_to_pattern(marker):
        r, c = marker
        return min((abs(r-y) + abs(c-x) for y, x, _ in colored), default=float('inf'))
    source_anchor = min(markers, key=distance_to_pattern)
    target_anchor = markers[1] if source_anchor == markers[0] else markers[0]
    sr, sc = source_anchor
    tr, tc = target_anchor
    out[tr][tc] = 0
    for r, c, color in colored:
        nr, nc = tr + r - sr, tc + c - sc
        if 0 <= nr < len(out) and 0 <= nc < len(out[0]):
            out[nr][nc] = color
    return out
'''
